newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Copene raised to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Copene raised to hold.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analysts Jacopo Valentine and Vladimir Pinto on Wednesday raised their rating for Brazil's Petroquimica do Nordeste SA, or Copene, to hold from sell.
-- They wrote in a report, "The stock price has fallen 19 percent year-to-date versus a 14 percent rise by the market through Feb 3."
-- They added, "We believe that the market has overreacted to the weak fourth quarter results, although we maintain our pessimistic view on the sector over the next few years."
